actions.add: Button that opens a dialog to add a row to a list. Imperative, ≤2 words. A + glyph is rendered separately.
actions.cancel: The dismiss button of a confirmation dialog, next to a destructive confirm button. Imperative, 1 word.
actions.close: aria-label of the ✕ button in the corner of a modal. Imperative, 1 word.
actions.create: Submit button of a create dialog. Imperative, 1 word.
actions.creating: Label that submit button shows while the create request is in flight. Ends with an ellipsis character.
actions.delete: Destructive button on a row or in a dialog. Imperative, 1 word.
actions.deleting: Label the destructive button shows while the delete is in flight. Ends with an ellipsis character.
actions.edit: Button that switches a value into an editable state. Imperative, 1 word.
actions.retry: Button that re-runs a request that failed. Imperative, ≤2 words — it sits in a narrow error panel.
actions.save: Primary submit button of a settings/config form. Imperative, ≤2 words.
actions.saved: Confirmation shown next to a submit button after success. Past tense, ≤2 words. A ✓ glyph is rendered separately in markup — do not include it.
actions.saving: Label a submit button shows while a save is in flight, replacing its normal label. Ends with an ellipsis character. ≤2 words — it must fit the same button as the label it replaces.
datePicker.calendarLabel: Accessible name of the month grid itself, used when the caller passes none. Never seen visually; it exists so Reka does not fall back to its own English literal. 1 word.
datePicker.clear: Button in the picker panel that empties the field / range. Imperative, 1 word.
datePicker.nav.nextMonth: aria-label of the › button that pages the calendar forward. The chevron stays in markup. ≤2 words.
datePicker.nav.prevMonth: aria-label of the ‹ button that pages the calendar back. The chevron stays in markup. ≤2 words.
datePicker.placeholder: Label on a single-date trigger with nothing chosen yet. Imperative, ≤3 words — the trigger is the width of a formatted date.
datePicker.presets.last7: Shortcut in the range picker's rail: the 7 days ending today, today included. The digit is part of the label, not a param — these are fixed windows, not a count.
datePicker.presets.last30: Shortcut in the range picker's rail: the 30 days ending today, today included.
datePicker.presets.last90: Shortcut in the range picker's rail: the 90 days ending today, today included.
datePicker.presets.prevMonth: Shortcut for the whole calendar month before this one, 1st to last day. Must not read as 'the last 30 days' — that is a different shortcut in the same rail. ≤2 words.
datePicker.presets.thisMonth: Shortcut for the 1st of the current month through today (NOT through the month's end — the range never runs into the future). ≤2 words.
datePicker.range.ariaValue: Accessible name of a range trigger that HAS a range. The visible label is two dates and an en dash; this is the spoken version, so it must read as a phrase. {from} and {to} arrive already formatted by d().
datePicker.range.placeholder: Label on a range trigger with nothing chosen yet, and its accessible name in that state. Imperative, ≤4 words.
dialog.fallbackTitle: Screen-reader-only title for a modal whose caller passed no title. Never seen visually; it exists so the dialog has an accessible name. 1 word.
form.required: Screen-reader-only text for the ' *' marker next to a required field's label. The asterisk itself stays in markup. 1 word.
form.selectPlaceholder: Placeholder inside a select that has no value chosen yet. Ends with an ellipsis character. ≤2 words.
pagination.goToPage: aria-label of those two buttons. {page} is the destination page number.
pagination.next: Button to the next page. The → glyph stays in markup. ≤1 word.
pagination.pageOf: Page position above a paginated table. ONE message with two params: {current} and {total}. Never split into fragments.
pagination.prev: Button to the previous page. The ← glyph stays in markup. ≤1 word, may be abbreviated.
state.loading: Combined aria-label and screen-reader text of a loading skeleton. One announcement, so it must read naturally when spoken. Ends with an ellipsis character.
state.noData: Fallback text in a table body when there are no rows AND the calling view supplied no better empty state. Deliberately neutral, ≤2 words.
